autoPermissionInstructions: This starts an OAuth login with the MCP server's authorization server and saves the login for every agent using that server's catalog.
capabilities: Configure Happy Agent MCP servers and reload them without restarting the daemon.
description: Logs in to an HTTP MCP server that needs a login (list_mcp_servers shows it as needs_auth). Call it when the person asks you to log in to that server. The person gets a sign-in link in a question only they can answer; after signing in, they paste back the address their browser opened. The login is saved for everyone using the same catalog: the user-wide MCP servers, or this folder's mcp.toml. The server then reconnects. The result is only the outcome. For a stdio server, it explains how to log in outside Happy instead.

server.description: The name of the MCP server to log in to, as list_mcp_servers shows it.

name: start_mcp_auth
